checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.why: Slow Sunday, Coffee first, Stay a little longer.
Same cream background and brown text, but slide 1 font is a heavier bold serif than slides 2-3, a mild inconsistency.
Cup, pour-over with mug, armchair with book and cup.
All text is clear and well inside the edges.

faults.what: Slide 1 headline font is much bolder and larger than on slides 2 and 3, so the set is less cohesive.
Illustrations are small and the layout is inconsistent. The chair on slide 3 sits off-centre to the left and the slides have a lot of empty space.
The requested paper texture is barely visible, and the slides are low resolution (640px).

summary: Three clean, square, cream-and-brown café slides with correct text and simple illustrations. The headline weight and size on slide 1 differ from the others, and the layouts are slightly inconsistent.
